instruction: Save the Word attachment from the latest Notes folder email into your Downloads folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the latest email in Notes folder (subject: 'Lecture Document'), accessing the Word attachment 'lecture-notes.docx' (122101 bytes verified from cache), and saving it to Downloads folder. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists at /home/user/Downloads/lecture-notes.docx (50%), (2) filename contains 'lecture' (25%), (3) file size >= 100KB indicating complete save (25%). Verified attachment size is 122101 bytes from cache extraction.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: uses env.controller.get_file() to check file existence and retrieve size from VM
Metric parameter handling is correct: directly accesses rules dict keys (expected.get('filename_contains'), expected.get('min_size')) as per framework behavior when expected.type='rule'
Complete verification coverage: checks file existence at correct path (50%), filename contains 'lecture' (25%), and file size >= 100KB (25%)
Expected values are semantically correct: filename_contains='lecture' matches attachment name, min_size=100000 matches verified size of 122101 bytes
File path is correctly hardcoded to /home/user/Downloads/lecture-notes.docx matching the specific attachment name
Logical flow is sound: getter extracts file state -> metric compares against rules -> scoring breakdown is appropriate
